title: LOW dynamic finding + bypass tag → aggregate severity LOW (D2: severity not raised by joining)
description: D2 boundary case in the OTHER direction. A LOW-severity unbounded loop fires on the dynamic side. The static bypass tag is present. Per D2, cross-mode support raises CONFIDENCE/PRIORITY but never raises SEVERITY above the dynamic finding's level. A LOW finding with cross-mode support stays LOW.

m2_expected.rationale: Per D2: cap_severity({low}) = low. Cross-mode joining cannot raise severity. Confidence does go up (lift_confidence on 2-component aggregate = 'high') because the join provides corroboration — but severity stays at the dynamic finding's level.
